items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Then my brother Robert, he died.

ctx.x: March. How much older was your brother Sam and Isaiah about? How many other members of the family were there too? I knew, of course, your youngest.

Well, I'm not the youngest brother, you see. Well, it was Sam. He was the oldest one. Then my brother Robert, he died. And I have another brother, Isaiah. And I came, a brother next to you, Isaiah. And come a brother, Albert, the bass player. He was much younger than the master. He was much younger than me, yeah. And I had another brother, but he didn't play music. He was the six of us that I could remember.
Did your father play any instruments?
